title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability… (CVE-2026-114526)
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Black Hole allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Black Hole versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.26.0, from 2.0.0 to 2.0.1.
